description: A blue bowl sits on the table with a small orange triangular piece inside, and nearby are a gray rectangular tray, some pink and green round pieces, and a couple small wrappers. The right hand moves in from the right and dips into the bowl to grasp the orange piece as a right-hand object, lifts it out, then carries it to the right and sets it down onto the gray tray before releasing; the left hand stays near the bowl without touching anything.
